description: Comedy by Jon Lucas and Scott Moore (2026): four lifelong friends escape their routines for a weekend at a luxury spa. Open-air screening, Monday to Wednesday; 6€ reduced, 5€ children, 5€ on Wednesdays.

Drama by Cristian Mungiu (2026, Palme d'Or) with Renate Reinsve and Sebastian Stan: a Romanian family settles in a remote Norwegian village, and their daughter's bruises set the community against them. Open-air screening, Monday to Wednesday; 6€ reduced, 5€ children, 5€ on Wednesdays.
